title: Dependencia y vulnerabilidad
goal: Read Peru's guano boom and bust as a case study in what single-commodity dependency costs, and understand why the region's export vulnerability was structural rather than accidental.

items: State what Peru's guano exports earned the state between 1840 and 1870.
Explain what that revenue was actually spent on.
Describe what happened to guano deposits and demand around 1870.
Explain why this boom-and-bust pattern repeated across the region.
Use si + past subjunctive with the conditional perfect to argue a historical "what if."
